name: CKEditor 5 Column Layout
description: Adds a CKEditor 5 tool to wrap text in resizable, responsive Flexbox columns via a Drupal modal.
project_description: The CKEditor 5 Column Layout module provides a responsive, flexbox-based grid system directly inside the Drupal rich-text editor. It lets content authors wrap text into multi-column sections (up to six columns) that stack differently at mobile, tablet, laptop, and desktop breakpoints, all configured through an in-editor modal rather than by hand-writing HTML or CSS. Columns are stored as plain div markup carrying data-xs/sm/md/lg attributes, and a bundled text-format filter plus an entity-presave hook strip the editor-only UI controls from the saved output so only structural markup and the responsive CSS reach the public page.
